svg.title: Silueta — what goes in, what comes out, and what never leaves
svg.desc: Two panels side by side. On the left, a shift report as a speech recogniser wrote it: "Shift report. Sophia Rays was with Mrs. Ellenor Vasques this morning. Her daughter Jamileth called at 602-555-0147 about the 3/14/2026 appointment." Every name is misspelled compared with the agency's roster, which is shown beneath as Sofía Reyes, Eleanor Vasquez and Yamilet Vasquez. An arrow labelled "matched by sound, then replaced under a policy" leads to the right panel, the same report as Silueta hands it on: "Shift report. Yael Rays was with Mrs. Ale Espinal this morning. Her daughter Chris called at [PHONE] about the 2026 appointment." People became other people and shapes became labels, but the surname "Rays" is still there and is marked as a failure the leak rate counts. Along the bottom: the manifest travels with the corpus, the vault never does, and the leak rate is measured rather than promised.
